x: Back in the field, Don Heath, who had been walking quite well, had to retire at 27 miles. Jack Baker and Pat Sapcote also had leg trouble and they too retired.
Then there followed all in quick succession the remaining five of the “ A ” Team, Don Heath, Hugh McGreechan, “Sir” Harry Shields, Joe Wilson and Dick Frazer.
In the early stages, Jack Bidgood Bert Clayton, Jack Baker, Jack Wakeley and George Oliver, walked in a group with Don Heath and Joe Wilson not far away.
This year saw DON HEATH - a member of our walking teams in the thirties, forties and fifties. For many years he has been living in Cornwall and is now back nearer to London.
